findings: The matrix API aggregates sensor/filter contact force; detailed API documented reconstruction multiplies scalar force by its normal.
Friction forces and points are exposed by the separate get_friction_data getter, which this acquisition did not record.
Interpret floor_total and floor-minus-momentum as normal-contact channel sums, not complete normal-plus-friction forces. Horizontal residual is not evidence of broken force balance.
Use the measured flat-floor vertical comparison only; shared backend agreement does not independently establish contact completeness.
